scope: Read-only public unauthenticated contract reachability and CORS checks; no product changes, auth, deployment, installation or credentials changes.
finding: All direct API/root/health/OPTIONS requests returned HTTP 302 text/html to same-host /__cookie_check.html. Ordinary root redirect returned HTTP 200 text/html Cookie check page requiring authentication/security-cookie permission. No quote JSON was obtained.
corsFinding: No Access-Control-Allow-* response headers observed on quotes GET, market-now GET, or quote OPTIONS from Toss preview Origin.
latencyFinding: Recorded times measure redirects/cookie page from this cloud executor, not quote engine response time or user device performance. They cannot substantiate or refute a 30-50ms internal quote-engine claim.
pairedRenderSamples: Not run: target did not expose usable quote JSON. Meaningful paired endpoint latency comparison requires identical successful quote payload requests.
integrationVerdict: Not safe to integrate or replace endpoints from current evidence. A public machine-readable quote endpoint with CORS and verified semantics is required before quote-only integration can be assessed.
frontendRisks: src/api.js uses a single API_BASE for all backend APIs. Changing VITE_CHARTVIEW_API_BASE swaps all API traffic, beyond quote-only scope.
Quote snapshots request tickers= comma-separated deduped symbols; live requests use fresh=true. Responses require results[] entries identified by ticker.
Quote timestamps/provenance are used for older-quote rejection and basis display; missing newer metadata can leave prior fields retained.
UI interprets change as percentage. Previous-close/session/currency values need backend parity validation.
Symbols must preserve .KS/.KQ suffixes, ^ index prefixes, and KRW=X.
corsLimit: These are gate responses; absent CORS headers do not establish the protected application own CORS configuration.
separateRenderObservations: render-existing.json: three ordinary serial samples; not paired with Cloud Run and not controlled cold starts.
naverSessionFollowup: naver-session-audit.json: one public GET; provider declares afterMarket; app copies provider timestamp and assigns regular_live from OPEN without session context. No quote/PICK changes.
